before.post: post _ d := zr_cellPost i choose wr dir d
before.lo: lo _ d j := min (d.workTapePos j) ((zr_cellPost i choose wr dir d).workTapePos j)
before.hi: hi _ d j := max (d.workTapePos j) ((zr_cellPost i choose wr dir d).workTapePos j)
before.run:
run _ d hd _ := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero,
      zr_cell_step i choose wr dir d hd]
before.cut:
cut _ d hd _ u hu := by
    have he : u = 0 := by omega
    subst u
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hd]
    rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    cases hb
before.env:
env _ d hd _ u hu j := by
    have he : u = 0 ∨ u = 1 := by omega
    rcases he with rfl | rfl
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_succ_eq_step', MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero,
        zr_cell_step i choose wr dir d hd]
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨min_le_right _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩

after.post: post _ d := zr_cellPost i choose wr dir d
after.lo: lo _ d j := min (d.workTapePos j) ((zr_cellPost i choose wr dir d).workTapePos j)
after.hi: hi _ d j := max (d.workTapePos j) ((zr_cellPost i choose wr dir d).workTapePos j)
after.run:
run _ d hd _ := by
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one,
      zr_cell_step i choose wr dir d hd]
after.cut:
cut _ d hd _ u hu := by
    have he : u = 0 := by omega
    subst u
    rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, hd]
    rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    cases hb
after.env:
env _ d hd _ u hu j := by
    have he : u = 0 ∨ u = 1 := by omega
    rcases he with rfl | rfl
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero]
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨min_le_left _ _, le_max_left _ _⟩
    · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_one,
        zr_cell_step i choose wr dir d hd]
      exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨min_le_right _ _, le_max_right _ _⟩
